content.title: 2022 AHA/ACC/HFSA Heart Failure Guideline
content.focus: The guideline discusses various interventions and studies related to heart failure treatment, including pharmacological treatments, surgical options, and impact on heart function.
keyPoints: Effects of carvedilol on heart function and anatomy (Reference 2).
Analyses of angiotensin receptor relationship in mitral regurgitation (Reference 4).
Effect of TAVR (Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement) in patients with severe aortic stenosis (Reference 8, 10, 11).
Evaluation of new therapeutic strategies in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) (Section 6.1).
Role of empagliflozin in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF) (References 6.1.1).
